name: Build & Donate 💸
desc:
Build & Donate is a game where you can claim a plot and build whatever you can imagine! Showcase your creative building talent, receive likes, and donate or make Robux all in one!

Unleash your creativity by drawing pixel art, crafting an epic obby, or designing houses and scary mazes - the possibilities are endless! Donations can take a few days to process, and the Robux you receive will be less due to Roblox taxes. Check your pending Robux here: https://www.roblox.com/transactions 

🔧 Build fun things! 
👍 Receive lots of likes! 
💸 Donate or earn Robux!
